items.title: SoundCloud confirms breach after member data stolen, VPN access disrupted
items.description: Audio streaming platform SoundCloud has confirmed that outages and VPN connection issues over the past few days were caused by a security breach in which threat actors stole a database containing user information. [...]

items.title: Google is shutting down its dark web report feature in January
items.description: Google is discontinuing its "dark web report" security tool, stating that it wants to focus on other tools it believes are more helpful. [...]

items.title: Askul confirms theft of 740k customer records in ransomware attack
items.description: Japanese e-commerce giant Askul Corporation has confirmed that RansomHouse hackers stole around 740,000 customer records in the ransomware attack it suffered in October. [...]
